newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mixed.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Monday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover fell sharply to 1.139 billion yuan from 2.311 billion last Friday with the 60-day contract the most active.
Traders said a speech by the governor of the central bank, Dai Xianglong, in Hong Kong on Saturday made major institutions cautious about trading on Monday.
Dai was quoted as saying that the central bank was likely to cut bank reserve ratios in the short term.
Traders said they believed the cut would inject large amounts of money into the system and this made investors reluctant to build heavy positions.
